title: Matching brackets
description:
Check whether the brackets in a line are balanced, with a stack.

```
(a[b]{c}) -> balanced
(a[b)]    -> mismatch at 5: expected ] but found )
((a)      -> 1 bracket left open
```
hints: A small function `char closerOf(char open)` gives `)` for `(` and so on (lesson 1.05).
After the loop, a non-empty stack means brackets were left open.
requirements: Push opening brackets onto a `std::stack<char>`; a closing bracket must match the top.
Report the position (from 1) of the first problem.
Characters that are not brackets are ignored.
stretch: Also accept `<` and `>` and quoted text in which brackets do not count.
